data.summary: This week, Ethan Qiu’s GitHub activity was centered on UTMIST/Misty, with 26 contribution-count commits, 18 pull requests opened, and 5 pull requests reviewed there. He also contributed to qiuethan/neetcode-submissions with 11 commits, Jeff15321/mathify-brief with 5 commits and pull requests #6, #7, and #8, and SomethingObvious/Valorant-Overseer with 2 commits and pull requests #1 and #2. He additionally opened issues in UTMIST/Misty and UTMIST/UTMIST, and opened pull requests #505 and #507 in UTMIST/UTMIST.
